recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量含粗大橘紅色顆粒的細胞，包括核呈圓形或凹陷的嗜伊紅性骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞與成熟雙葉嗜伊紅球，部分前驅細胞顆粒偏暗紫，顯示嗜伊紅球系各階段增生。
features: Numerous eosinophil lineage cells dominating the field
Eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with round, indented or bilobed nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse orange-red granules
Occasional precursors with darker purplish immature granules
Scattered larger immature cells with open chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm (promyelocytes/myelocytes)
Small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and a segmented neutrophil in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked eosinophilic hyperplasia with abundant eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature forms containing coarse orange-red granules; a subset of precursors has darker, immature-appearing granules. Scattered immature granulocytic cells, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors are present, without an obvious excess of blasts in this field. Findings are consistent with bone marrow eosinophilia; correlation with peripheral eosinophil count, clinical history and cytogenetic/molecular testing for eosinophilia-associated rearrangements is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar maturing eosinophils; excluded by clinical history and lack of clonal markers.
Requires clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormality or increased blasts, often with dysplastic eosinophils.
Shows spindle-shaped CD25-positive mast cell aggregates on biopsy and KIT D816V mutation.
Abnormal eosinophils contain large purple-violet granules with increased myelomonocytic blasts.
